name: manual_deab30
claim: Authorization proof claims need explicit compatibility semantics: mandatory normalized launch fields always bind, while optional verifier-issued claims fail closed when present and remain compatible only under documented absent-claim behavior.

decisions.notes: The governance reconciliation combined tuple binding with optional path and scope claims without treating policy metadata as signature or task-ownership verification.

rationale: The governance reconciliation combined tuple binding with optional path and scope claims without treating policy metadata as signature or task-ownership verification.
